# The parts of Qt that Bloom uses (docs/architecture/platform-support.md, "Qt").
#
# One line per part: its kind, its name, where it is used and what for.
#
#   kind      `module` (a Qt library Bloom links) or `plugin` (a Qt plugin a package carries).
#   name      The part's name in Qt's own software bill of materials, which is also its CMake
#             target name (Qt6::<name>).
#   where     `all`, or the operating systems: `linux`, `macos`, `windows`.
#   use       `package` when Bloom's packages carry it, `build` when only the build and the
#             tests use it.
#
# The cmake/BloomQtModuleCheck.cmake check holds the build to this list: a Qt part the build
# names that is not listed here is refused, and so is a listed part that the locked Qt's bill of
# materials does not offer under LGPL-3.0-only. Every other part of Qt is left out of the
# packages.
module Core all package
module Gui all package
module Widgets all package
module Network all package
module Svg all package
# Qt Gui loads Qt D-Bus on Linux and on macOS.
module DBus linux macos package
module Test all build

# Libraries the plugins below load.
module OpenGL linux package
module XcbQpaPrivate linux package
module WaylandClient linux package

plugin QXcbIntegrationPlugin linux package
plugin QXcbGlxIntegrationPlugin linux package
plugin QXcbEglIntegrationPlugin linux package
plugin QWaylandIntegrationPlugin linux package
plugin QWaylandXdgShellIntegrationPlugin linux package
plugin QWaylandBradientDecorationPlugin linux package
plugin QWaylandEglClientBufferPlugin linux package
plugin QComposePlatformInputContextPlugin linux package
plugin QIbusPlatformInputContextPlugin linux package
plugin QXdgDesktopPortalThemePlugin linux package
plugin QTlsBackendOpenSSLPlugin linux package
plugin QCocoaIntegrationPlugin macos package
plugin QMacStylePlugin macos package
plugin QSecureTransportBackendPlugin macos package
plugin QWindowsIntegrationPlugin windows package
plugin QModernWindowsStylePlugin windows package
plugin QSchannelBackendPlugin windows package
plugin QOffscreenIntegrationPlugin all package
plugin QSvgPlugin all package
plugin QSvgIconPlugin all package
